entities.summary: Alex John Meyer is an American former professional baseball pitcher. He played college baseball for the Kentucky Wildcats and has played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Minnesota Twins and the Los Angeles Angels. He officially announced his retirement from baseball on June 25, 2019, due to injuries. He last played for the Angels in 2017.
